first_semantic_review.review_type: Manual inspection of original first response; criteria and expected facts independent of product helpers.

criteria.d0_gap: Ask whether D0 is guaranteed to pass through 0 between adjacent pieces; asking which rearm policy to choose alone is insufficient.
criteria.same_piece_change: Ask whether D0 may change for the same physical piece.
criteria.rearm: Ask the condition that permits registering the next physical piece.
criteria.injection_before_shift: Explicitly ask how a pending classification is held before the next Encoder shift.
criteria.injection_after_shift: Ask when classification bits are consumed/reset after shift.
criteria.start_stop_levels: Ask pressed input levels for both buttons.
criteria.supported_structures: Do not approximate tracking as a register counter or state machine.
criteria.no_unconfirmed_button_trigger: Do not project rising/falling/level button triggers while pressed levels remain unknown.
